name: DescribeDedicatedBlockStorageClusters

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the dedicated block storage cluster. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2680071.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The zone ID of the dedicated block storage cluster. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25610.html operation to query the most recent zone list
parameters.help_zh: 可用区ID，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25610.html获取可用区列表
parameters.name: azone_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the dedicated block storage clusters. You can specify the IDs of multiple dedicated block storage clusters in a request
parameters.help_zh: 由一个或多个专属块存储集群id组成的数组格式
parameters.name: dedicated_block_storage_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The states of dedicated block storage clusters. Valid values:

Preparing
Running
Expired
Offline

Multiple states can be specified. Valid values of N: 1, 2, 3, and 4
parameters.help_zh:
专属块存储集群的状态。取值范围：

Preparing：待交付。
Running：运行中。
Expired：集群到期。
Offline：下线。

可同时设置多个状态，取值范围为1~4
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The category of disks that can be created in the dedicated block storage cluster.

Set the value to cloud_essd. Only enhanced SSDs (ESSDs) can be created in dedicated block storage clusters
parameters.help_zh:
专属块存储集群可创建的云盘类型。

取值仅支持cloud_essd，即ESSD云盘
parameters.name: category

fields.help_en: The tag key of the dedicated block storage cluster
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value of the dedicated block storage cluster
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tags. Up to 20 tags are supported
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表，最多包含20个子项
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the dedicated block storage cluster belongs
parameters.help_zh: 专属集群所在的企业资源组ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158855.html查询资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The query token. Set the value to the NextToken value that is returned in the last call
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken参数值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return in each request that uses a token to perform a query
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。
取值范围1-100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: A string generated by the server as an identifier for clients to send requests
parameters.help_zh: 服务端生成的一串字符串，作为客户端进行请求的一个标识
parameters.name: client_token
